Please give it some attention
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers should check in early, keep carrier labels clear, and have travel papers ready before arriving at Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep pets calm and secured while moving through the terminal, and follow all guidance from the welcome team and ground staff. <<FACT F002>> Bring any needed food, water, and comfort items in approved containers, and let the desk know right away if your plans change or if your pet seems unwell.

Our team works to move carriers carefully between services and to help each traveler with steady, respectful support. Clear communication helps us keep the process smooth for everyone, and it also helps protect pets during busy periods. If you need help with boarding steps, carry-on rules, or handoff details, please speak with us before you reach the gate.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance with your pet travel needs.
